blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Solve five x plus seven equals three x plus nineteen. Type the value of x.
Subtract three x from both sides, by the subtraction property of equality. That leaves two x plus seven equals nineteen.
Subtract seven from both sides, by the subtraction property of equality. Two x equals twelve.
Divide both sides by two, by the division property of equality. X equals six.
Watch out for these traps. If you add seven instead of subtracting it, you get thirteen. If you stop before the last division, you get twelve.
